bio.text: John Bolton is the Republican nominee for Connecticut Attorney General in 2026.

He is a lawyer with a solo practice in Westport, where CT Mirror describes him as having formerly served on the Planning and Zoning Commission; the Westport Journal reported in March 2026 that he had been a member since 2021 and a full commissioner since 2023, and that he has lived in Westport since 1997.

A native of West Hartford, he has practiced law for 35 years, including time as in-house counsel for companies in upstate New York and Alabama, and ran unsuccessfully for state representative in Westport in 2024.

sources.title: John Bolton, attorney and P&Z commissioner, announces state AG bid
